messages:
amar: anyone else seeing chart stutters on canary after the morning deploy? heatmap and sparklines feel choppy
lee: yup, noticed on /app/ops-telemetry. main-thread parse time up a lot for some users
violet: grabbed a trace: big chunk parse + zlib inflate on the vendor bundle. chunk size ~5MB now.
chris: that correlates with the splitpoint tweak in PR #3421  changed the heatmap renderer to a separate chunk but ended up pulling in a heavy util lib
amar: CDN logs show repeated requests for chunk-heatmap.* with low cache-hit ratio, many 200s but no edge hits on first view
lee: also saw routing policy churn this morning (weights updated) which may reduce kv affinity and cause more cross-region misses
violet: repro in local canary: disabling the new splitpoint makes panning smooth again. adding rel=preload speeds cold start too
deploy-bot: deploy by @chris at 2026-03-21 10:12 UTC to canary (10%) :white_check_mark:
chris: hotfix plan: revert splitpoint change, reintroduce preload hints for the chunk, and add CI perf check for parse time on first paint
amar: we should also add a telemetry gate: alert when "kv-hit-rate" < 85% for 5m or "main_thread_parse_ms" > 500ms after deploy
lee: agree. and add a note to avoid coupling routing weight changes with chunking work in the same rollout
violet: I'll open PERF-1245 with repro steps and perf test to catch chunk regressions
amar: rolling back canary now and monitoring metrics
deploy-bot: rollback started by @amar at 2026-03-21 10:18 UTC
chris: rollback confirmed, canary LCP back down ~300ms in initial checks
amar: thanks y'all — follow-up: chunk budget review in next sprint and telemetry regression in CI
lee: :thumbsup:
violet: will add a dashboard to track chunk sizes and preload missing count per route
amar: closing this thread unless we see the LCP spike reappear
